pairs.difference: A has a sharper mouth opening and ring; B has a darker lower mouth edge. Both have clean outer boundaries and restrained internal seams, without a convincing drawn outline.
B packs closely spaced dark boundaries into the cord wrapping and nested horn loops. A has broader, more separated wraps and fewer competing internal edges.
pairs.fix: Use fewer, broader cord wraps, with narrow soft separations. Keep the horn's inner curves clean without dark tracing.

pairs.difference: B's steam has several long, clearly bounded ribbons, and its cup base has a strong dark separation. A's steam fades into the background and its foot has a thinner, quieter boundary.
pairs.fix: Draw one softly fading curl of steam. Make the cup's foot seam thin and subtle.

pairs.difference: B's basket has many narrow, sharply separated wicker strips and extra parallel lines along the handle. A uses broader woven bands with fewer internal boundaries.
pairs.fix: Draw wider wicker bands and a simpler twisted handle. Keep small wicker seams faint.

pairs.difference: A has more rivet edges and stronger deck grain; B has longer dark stave seams. Both retain clean silhouettes and narrow internal divisions consistent with the references.
B has continuous dark borders around the windshield and side windows, plus thick dark grille divisions. A's window and grille edges are finer and interrupted by bright metal edges.
pairs.fix: Use thin window seals and slender grille bars. Break up dark borders with soft transitions and small bright edges.

pairs.difference: B gives distant tree crowns and individual background needles strong, repeated boundaries while the tent has relatively few edges. A keeps the tent seams crisp and the distant foliage softer.
pairs.fix: Soften distant foliage and merge small leaf and needle edges into larger groups. Keep the tent opening and nearest seams clearest.

pairs.difference: A has more small boundaries in the pot's speckled surface; B concentrates them in the soup, rope ties, and stone ring. Neither shows a consistently heavier outline or clearly unsuitable edge hierarchy.

pattern: Generated examples often replace fine, selective seams with broad dark divisions, or repeat crisp small boundaries across wicker, cord, steam, and background foliage. Edge emphasis becomes less selective.
